title: FinGuard India – RBI original data (attributes needed for the 8 ratios), FY22–FY25
notes: Values exactly as published by RBI (annual, as on 31 March). Amounts in ₹ crore; ratios in %. No calculations, no projections. Blue = RBI data. Yellow = LCR, not available in the supplied RBI files.
Year = financial year ending 31 March (e.g. 2025 = FY25).
source_overview: All data: RBI, "Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India" (DBIE, data.rbi.org.in), as supplied in the five Excel files. Scope: the 20 banks in the FinGuard project; standalone bank-level data; FY22–FY25.

ratio_attribute_map.note: Net NPA ÷ net advances. RBI "Advances" in the balance sheet is net of provisions.
RBI publishes CRAR directly; risk-weighted assets are not in the files, so it cannot be rebuilt from raw items.

ratio_attribute_map.attributes_needed: Net profit; Total assets (year end, and previous year end for average)
ratio_attribute_map.note: Choose year-end or average assets and use it for every bank.

ratio_attribute_map.attributes_needed: Net interest income (or Interest earned − Interest expended); Total assets
ratio_attribute_map.note: RBI defines NIM here as net interest income ÷ total assets.
Not in the RBI files supplied. Needs each bank's Basel III / Pillar 3 disclosure (HQLA and net cash outflows, or the LCR % itself).

ratio_attribute_map.attributes_needed: Operating expenses; Net interest income; Other income
ratio_attribute_map.note: Operating expenses ÷ (net interest income + other income).

ratio_attribute_map.attributes_needed: Borrowings; Capital; Reserves and surplus (Deposits if total-liability basis)
ratio_attribute_map.note: Pick one definition and apply it to all banks.

ratio_attribute_map.attributes_needed: Gross NPA – closing; Net NPA – closing
ratio_attribute_map.note: (Gross NPA − Net NPA) ÷ Gross NPA. Excludes written-off amounts.
